metaTitle: Best Oval Area Rugs for Living Rooms (2026)
metaDescription: Six oval area rugs compared by size, pile height, backing and washability, from 3x5 entry rugs to 6x9 room rugs and shag oval accents.
expertTake: The Hazo Haus 5x8 black oval rug is our top pick for a dining or living area, because it lists a quarter inch low pile, a rubber backing and machine washability in a size that suits a table or a seating group. The Soalmost 3x5 is the value pick for an entry. Skip oval rugs if your furniture is boxy and pushed to the walls, since an oval leaves awkward bare corners under square pieces. Whatever you pick, add a little size to allow for the rounded ends.
introParagraphs: An oval rug softens a room full of straight lines. It suits round and oval tables, curved sofas and entryways, and it makes a small space feel less boxy. It also needs thought, since the rounded ends leave less floor covered than a rectangle of the same stated size.

Most oval rugs at this level are washable polyester with a rubber backing, and a few are plush shag. The size, the pile height and the backing decide whether a rug works under a table, in an entry or beside a bed, and the room shape decides whether an oval looks right at all. We compare published specifications here, so measure your space before you buy.

products.name: Hazo Haus Washable Oval Rug 5x8 Black Farmhouse Low Pile

specList.label: Use
specList.value: Dining room, kitchen table, living room

products.description:
The Hazo Haus is a 5 by 8 foot oval rug in black farmhouse styling, with a 0.25 inch low pile, a strong non-slip rubber backing and machine washability. The listing says it resists messes such as pet hair and is suited to kids and pets.

A 5 by 8 oval is long enough for a table with chairs pulled out, or a seating group in a small room, and the low pile means chairs slide on it easily. Black hides spills but shows lint and light dust, and the printed pattern on a polyester rug is not as durable as a woven one. Compared with the Othilic 6x9, the Hazo Haus is smaller and cheaper, and suits tighter spaces.

Use a pad if the floor is hardwood, vacuum without the beater bar and wash according to the label. Air dry to protect the rubber backing. Centre it under the table so that the chairs remain on the rug even when pulled out, and leave an even border of bare floor around it. If the floor is tile, a thin pad stops the rug from creeping while chairs scrape back.

products.name: Othilic Tan Oval Rug 6x9 Floral Scalloped Edge Washable

specList.label: Care
specList.value: Machine washable, kids and pets friendly

products.description:
The Othilic is a 6 by 9 foot tan oval with a delicate floral pattern, a scalloped edge and a faux wool surface. The listing calls it machine washable, soft and friendly to kids and pets.

The scalloped edge softens the oval further, and a tan floral pattern suits a farmhouse or vintage room. At 6 by 9 it is the largest oval here and fits a dining table with chairs for six or a living room seating group. The higher tier reflects the size. Faux wool is soft but crushes and holds oily dirt, so shake it out regularly.

A rug that big needs a laundromat for washing. Use a pad, and rotate the rug every six months. Because the scalloped edge is a design detail, avoid dragging heavy furniture across it, and vacuum around the scallops with a brush attachment so dust does not collect in the curves. Rotate the rug so one end does not fade from sun.

products.name: NakedCloud 5x7 Oval Washable Rug Green Floral Low-Pile
products.description:
The NakedCloud is a 5 by 7 foot oval rug in a green botanical floral design, made of low pile microfibre with a high density surface and a wear resistant non-slip backing. It is listed as washable and stain resistant.

A botanical pattern suits a cottage or vintage room, and a 5 by 7 oval fits a bedroom, a breakfast nook or a small living room. Microfibre is soft, and the high density surface helps it hold its shape. As with most printed rugs, the pattern can fade with wear, and the backing needs a pad on hardwood. Against the Hazo Haus 5x8, it is smaller and a little lower in tier.

Vacuum with the beater bar raised, spot clean and air dry after washing. A botanical pattern in green pairs well with plain linen or cotton in cream, and with wood tones. Keep it out of strong afternoon light, where printed greens can fade faster than neutrals. If you wash it, check the care label for temperature, because hot water can fade printed greens.

products.name: Ophanie 4x6 Oval Ivory Fluffy Shag Rug Plush Soft
products.description:
The Ophanie is a 4 by 6 foot ivory oval shag rug made of polyester, with a high density plush surface and a non-slip backing. The listing pitches it for layering and a hygge look in bedrooms and living rooms.

A shag oval is the cosiest option here and the hardest to keep clean. Ivory shows dirt quickly, and the long fibres trap crumbs and hair, so it needs shaking and suction vacuuming. It works as a layered rug on top of a larger flat rug, which is a popular style. Compared with the LOCHAS runner shaped oval, the Ophanie is wider and a bit higher in tier.

Shake it weekly, use a rug rake and keep it away from chairs on casters. A shag oval looks best layered over a larger flat rug, with the shag shape offset at the foot of the bed, so the plush surface is where bare feet land first. Rake the pile after furniture dents it.

products.name: Soalmost Small Oval 3x5 Washable Rug Beige Low Pile
products.description:
The Soalmost is a 3 by 5 foot beige oval rug with a vintage low pile, geometric patterns and a non-slip backing. The listing calls it pet friendly and machine washable, and suited to an entryway, kitchen or nursery.

A 3 by 5 size fits a home washing machine more easily and is useful at the sink, the door or a changing table. It is a mat, not a room rug, so it will not anchor furniture. Beige hides dust and sits well with many floors. Compared with the NakedCloud, it is simpler, smaller and lower priced.

Shake it weekly, wash on a delicate cycle and air dry. Use a pad if the floor is smooth. In a kitchen, place it at the sink where drips fall, and wash it more often than you would a bedroom rug. A thin pad underneath prevents sliding on tile or hardwood.

products.name: LOCHAS Soft Oval Shaggy Rug 2.6x5.3 Grey Bedroom
products.description:
The LOCHAS is a grey oval shaggy rug measuring 2.6 by 5.3 feet, with a top layer of 1.77 inch plush microfibres. It is the cheapest piece in the lineup and suits a bedside or a kid's room.

A runner proportioned oval fits along a bed or a hallway nook, and a 1.77 inch plush pile is very cosy underfoot but crushes and traps dirt. It is small enough to wash by hand or in a home machine on a gentle cycle, although plush pile dries slowly. Compared with the Ophanie, the LOCHAS is narrower and cheaper.

Shake it weekly and comb the pile with a rake. Keep it out of damp spaces. Place it along the side of the bed so the plush pile meets your feet when you get up. If a pet shares the room, check the pile weekly for hair and use a rake to loosen it.

buyingCriteria.explanation: An oval rug works best under a round or oval table, with a curved sofa or at a bed side. Under boxy furniture it leaves bare corners that look unfinished. For a dining table, choose a rug at least 24 inches wider than the table on each side so chairs stay on it. A quick way to test is to cut an oval out of newspaper at the stated size and lay it on the floor, then see how the furniture sits around it. Curved sofas, round poufs and arched mirrors repeat the oval shape and make the whole room feel designed rather than assembled.

The rounded ends cover less floor than a rectangle of the same stated size. A 5 by 8 oval covers roughly 31 square feet against 40 for a rectangle. Add a size when you are replacing a rectangular rug. In a narrow room, choose an oval whose width leaves at least 12 inches of floor each side, since a wide oval can crowd the walls. If the listing gives only the size and no area, work out the area yourself with the oval formula before comparing.

Low pile, a quarter inch or less, as on the Hazo Haus, suits dining chairs and doors. Shag, as on the Ophanie, is cosy but traps crumbs. A plush pile of an inch or more is for bedsides, not high traffic. If the room has a robot vacuum, avoid shag ovals, because the long fibres wrap around the brush.

A rubber or TPE backing grips, but can mark some floors. A pad under an oval rug keeps the rounded edges from curling. Trim the pad about an inch smaller than the rug on all sides. On carpet, use a thin mesh pad rather than a thick felt pad, so the oval does not ride up.

Rugs up to about 5 by 7 usually fit a home washer. Larger ovals, like the 6 by 9 Othilic, need a laundromat. Air dry and avoid dryers. If you wash a rug at a laundromat, use a large front loader and the gentle cycle, and air dry at home.

Botanical florals suit cottage and vintage rooms. Black and neutrals suit modern farmhouse. Printed patterns on polyester can fade with sun and wear, so keep rugs out of strong light. If your room has patterned wallpaper, choose a plainer oval so the two do not compete.

maintenance.why: Beater bars loosen printed pile. Suction keeps it intact. Vacuum the rounded ends too, since dust collects along the curves.
Stains set quickly. Blot with mild soap and warm water. Never scrub, because scrubbing pushes stains deeper into the pile.
Rotation spreads wear and sun fading.
Ovals curl at the ends. A pad or tape keeps them flat. Double sided rug tape keeps rounded ends from lifting.

faq.q: Do oval rugs make a room look smaller?
faq.a: No, they can soften a boxy room. They cover less floor than a rectangle, so size up a little. If your room is long and narrow, an oval can feel shorter than a rectangle of the same length.

faq.q: What size oval goes under a dining table?
faq.a: Choose a rug at least 24 inches wider than the table on each side so chairs stay on the rug. Measure the table, add 24 inches on each side and pick the nearest oval that covers that area.

faq.q: Can I put an oval rug under a sofa?
faq.a: Yes, but a boxy sofa leaves bare corners. A rectangle often suits it better. A curved sofa or a round coffee table pairs well with an oval rug.

faq.q: Can I machine wash an oval rug?
faq.a: Small ones can. Larger ovals need a laundromat. Air dry.
The rounded ends can curl. A pad or double sided tape helps. If the ends curl, flatten them with a heavy book overnight, or use tape.
A low tier rug suits a bedside or entry. Spend more for a larger size. Remember that a pad is an extra purchase that protects both rug and floor.
